status.comment:
Implemented: SessionMemory (packages/wrapped-agents/common/src/session-memory.ts) persists per-session summaries to .bowman/memory/sessions and loadSessionMemoryContext injects loadRecentSummaries + the system-friction summary into the next session's instruct context. Cross-session memory exists and is wired into the watchdog.

Outcome: Verified implemented in code (SessionMemory + loadSessionMemoryContext) and marked done. Effectiveness: Quick, high-confidence: the feature is present and wired. Lesson: Cross-session memory was already built and merely unmarked — typical of the stale-status drift the sweep targets. Pattern: reconcile-not-rebuild
